task_definition.task_name: Travel Time Calculation and Curve Plotting

task_description.overview: Compute and plot travel time curves for seismic phases over a given distance range using a standard velocity model.
steps: Load or reference the seismic velocity model (e.g., iasp91).
Define source depth and distance range for travel time calculation.
Select the seismic phases to plot (e.g., P, PP, S).
Use the travel-time computation function to calculate arrival times.
Render the travel time curves on a 2D plot.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Generate a travel time curve plot for seismic phases. Use the iasp91 velocity model at a source depth of 10 km. Calculate arrival times for phases P, PP, and S over distances from 0° to 180°, attention the basic physics of the wave propagation. Output a figure to show the 'distance-travel time' relationship. Save the travel time curve plot to {travel_time_curve_plot}.
